headline: Building Maintenance Technician
summary: Building maintenance technician with three years looking after a hotel and office building in Ifugao. I repair electrical, plumbing and mechanical problems, keep lighting and office equipment working, and fix doors, walls and ceilings. I answer tenants' and guests' requests quickly and politely.

experience.title: Building Maintenance Technician
experience.employer: Ifugao Terraces View Hotel and Offices
experience.paragraph: One of two technicians for a 40-room hotel and a three-storey office building.
bullets: Repair outlets, switches and circuits and install new wiring for added equipment.
Maintain pumps, water heaters and aircon units on a monthly schedule.
Replace and repair lighting fixtures, ballasts and exit lights.
Set up projectors, printers and sound systems for meetings and events.
Fix doors, ceilings and walls, and repair small electronic devices.

experience.title: Maintenance Helper
bullets: Assisted in plumbing and electrical repairs and painted guest rooms.
Responded to guest requests for repairs.

skills: Mechanical maintenance of pumps and aircons
Customer service for guests and tenants

education.credential: Electrical Installation and Maintenance NC II
